elements_source: JPL / Standish, 'Keplerian Elements for Approximate Positions of the Major Planets', valid 1800-2050. Elements and per-century rates are carried verbatim so the module can advance them; the polylines below are sampled at T = 0.

frames.note: Apply ecliptic_to_supergalactic to seat the solar system in the same frame as the star bubble and galaxy field. The Sun is at the origin, which is also the Milky Way's position in the supergalactic layers - the scale ladder, not a translation, separates them.
